about_the_game:
A first-person game set in the Mekong Delta region of Vietnam.

It tells the story of Hai, a young man consumed by alcohol and gambling, perpetually trapped in debt and endless intoxication. Hai is also the main cause of domestic violence, with his wife as the primary victim.

And Yen, Hai’s wife — a virtuous and kind-hearted elementary school teacher, beloved by the whole village, yet forced to endure endless suffering at the hands of her husband.

One day, Yen tragically dies in an accident. From that moment on, nightmares and strange, otherworldly events begin to relentlessly descend upon Hai’s life…

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains some mild violent scenes, as well as depictions of accident sites and fights, with occasional appearances of blood (low frequency). It also includes metaphorical references to alcohol consumption. While not overly graphic, the content may not be suitable for children
